subject: English
title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class XI

source.read: HSE first-year (Class XI) English: prose, poem, supplementary, vocabulary, grammar and writing, as set out in the question pattern and summarised by exam-guide sites
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. The official syllabus and question pattern could not be read from the build environment; this list comes from secondary summaries of the board's English paper and the class textbook. The textbook's own chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Gives words of the same and opposite meaning.
Forms compound and blended words, and expands abbreviations.
Splits words into syllables.
Uses prefixes and suffixes, and words often confused.
Uses phrasal verbs and idioms.
Changes sentences between active and passive.
Uses degrees of comparison.
Reports a dialogue in reported speech.
Fills in conditional clauses.
Transforms simple, compound and complex sentences.
Spots and corrects errors in sentences.
Reads the prose lessons and answers questions on them.
outcomes.note: Long reads practise questions on theme, character and plot on OpenPath's own stories; the board's own textbook chapters are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Answers poem-appreciation questions on poetic devices.
